qa_pairs.question: What is component number 15 in this shift layout drawing?
What does the shift gate component connect to in this automatic transmission layout?
qa_pairs.answer: The shift gate (component 11) connects to the transmission switch (component 12) in the assembly.

qa_pairs.question: Which component number represents the cable in this diagram?
What is the function of component 12 according to the parts list?
Where is the selector lever positioned in relation to the shift gate?
qa_pairs.answer: The selector lever (component 13) is positioned adjacent to and works in conjunction with the shift gate (component 11).

qa_pairs.question: What components make up the transmission lever assembly at the bottom of the diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: The transmission lever assembly includes the transmission lever (component 24), holder (component 21), washers (components 25 and 26), sleeve (component 27), and clamping bolt (component 28).

qa_pairs.question: What is component number 20 in this shift layout?
Which components are identified as self-tapping screws in this assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: Components 3, 4, 9, and 10 are identified as self-tapping screws in the parts list.
